instruction: Parking and service block IFC model. Create a two-level parking and service block from scratch in Revit and export it to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the IFC4 schema. The design must include a ramp between the two levels, a pedestrian stair, and a small plant space. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, one IfcSpace, four IfcWall elements, two IfcSlab elements, and one IfcRamp. Name the space so it includes Plant. Include at least one IfcStair, one IfcDoor, and one IfcWindow. Do not include IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. Size the shaped model so its bounding box spans 22.0-26.0 m in X, 14.5-17.5 m in Y, and 3.2-4.5 m in Z. Ramp slope, parking striping, and nonrequired details may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
